name: Saloon (sedan)
definition: passenger car with a separate boot behind a fixed roof over two rows of seats.

name: Hatchback
definition: passenger car whose rear door is a top-hinged tailgate opening onto the load space.

name: Estate (station wagon)
definition: passenger car with the roof carried back to the rear and a tailgate over a long load space.

name: Coupé
definition: closed passenger car with a fixed roof, two doors and a sloping rear.

name: Convertible (cabriolet)
definition: passenger car whose roof folds or comes off.

name: SUV
definition: passenger car with a tall body, raised ground clearance and often four-wheel drive.

name: MPV (minivan)
definition: passenger car with a tall one-box body and up to three rows of seats where the load space would be.

name: Microcar (quadricycle)
definition: light enclosed four-wheeled car below the ordinary car class, sold as its own category.
notes: sold as Microcar moped cars (AM licence), drivable from age 15

name: Panel van
definition: goods vehicle with an enclosed windowless load box behind the cab.

name: Pickup truck
definition: light goods vehicle with a cab and an open load bed.

name: Chassis-cab with fitted body (rigid truck)
definition: truck built on one chassis with its body fitted (box, dropside, tipper).
notes: chassis cab with dropside, tipper bodies

name: Tractor unit
definition: truck made to tow a semi-trailer on a fifth-wheel coupling.

name: Minibus
definition: passenger vehicle with four or more rows of seats, below bus size.

name: Limousine
definition: long-wheelbase chauffeur-driven car with a partition or extended rear passenger compartment.
notes: stretch and non-stretch limousines built on Mercedes, Cadillac, Lincoln and others

name: Window van (kombi)
definition: van with side windows and seats or space for passengers and goods.
notes: sold as Kombi / passenger van, e.g. Ford Transit Custom Kombi

name: Bus / coach
definition: large passenger vehicle for many seated or standing passengers.

name: Standard (naked) motorcycle
definition: general-purpose motorcycle with an upright riding position and little or no fairing.

name: Cruiser motorcycle
definition: low-seated motorcycle with feet-forward controls and a laid-back riding position.

name: Sport motorcycle
definition: motorcycle built for speed and handling, with a forward-leaning position and full fairing.

name: Touring motorcycle
definition: large motorcycle made for long distances, with wind protection, luggage and passenger comfort.

name: Adventure / dual-sport motorcycle
definition: motorcycle made for both road and unpaved riding, with long suspension travel.

name: Moped
definition: light low-powered two-wheeler with a small engine or motor and no working pedal drive.
